A coordination service name must contain the Coordination identifier.

What The Standard says

“Variations” — The Standard names an orchestration service that depends on downstream orchestration services a Coordination service. Including Coordination in the class name exposes that architectural level. read it here.

Why it matters

The Coordination suffix advertises that the service combines orchestration-level capabilities. It makes the service's permitted dependencies and higher-level responsibility obvious and prevents it from being confused with an orchestration or management service.

Bad code example

// Violates STXC002: A coordination service name must contain the Coordination identifier.
class StudentService(IStudentOrchestrationService students) : IStudentService { }

Good code example

// Follows STXC002
class StudentCoordinationService(IStudentOrchestrationService students) : IStudentCoordinationService { }
